svg.aria-label: Six boxes of particles. (a) Helium atoms, all alike: an element. (b) O2 molecules, each two oxygen atoms bonded: an element. (c) Water molecules, one O bonded to two H: a compound. (d) Separate helium and neon atoms: a mixture of elements. (e) N2 and O2 molecules together, like air: a mixture of elements. (f) Water molecules with O2 molecules: a mixture of a compound and an element.
svg.text: He and Ne atoms, not bonded
